positions.title: Co-Founder, CTO
positions.description:
Led the development of a GPS tracking SaaS platform serving over 50,000 customers and tracking more than 300,000 vehicles and assets. Collaborated with major clients like Lululemon, Tesla, and TJ Maxx, delivering innovative tracking solutions across logistics, construction, and retail.
* Spearheaded the migration of $24M ARR from a third-party provider to an in-house platform, achieving 99.998% uptime for over 60,000 users and enhancing product control.
* Partnered with Google Maps to integrate advanced geospatial features, resulting in a 30% increase in customer engagement through improved user experience.
* Collaborated with Queclink to deploy firmware updates that reduced device latency by 25%, ensuring a more reliable tracking experience.
* Designed and implemented theft recovery features using Hapn's API, increasing customer retention by 30% through enhanced asset management capabilities.
* Managed a global team of 20+ engineers across five time zones, fostering collaboration and ensuring timely project delivery under tight deadlines.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Marketplace
positions.description:
Contributed to the AWS Marketplace Framework team, developing scalable and secure solutions for cloud-based infrastructure.
* Developed a scalable widget framework that improved user engagement by 20%, integrating React-based solutions into AWS consoles for enhanced third-party add-on adoption.
* Enhanced AWS Marketplace metrics collection systems, reducing downtime by 12% and ensuring zero data loss while supporting millions of daily transactions.
* Optimized backend architecture to reduce latency by 15% through effective load balancing and API optimization, ensuring reliable service under high traffic.
* Implemented advanced security protocols, safeguarding sensitive data across multiple projects and aligning with global compliance requirements.

positions.title: Lead Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Led core product development and digital services for a location-based training platform.
* Led the development of a location-based training platform, building modules that significantly improved field tech assessments, reducing operational errors by 30% in high-stakes environments like underground pipe location, where mistakes could lead to catastrophic incidents.
* Increased training effectiveness by 40% by designing a VR-based Locate Simulator using Unity and IoT architecture, enabling personnel to safely practice underground surveying.
* Developed a real-time data processing web application for underground survey operations, allowing technicians to visualize and manage data from multiple IoT devices in the field, improving platform reliability by 30%.
